goal: SDE-2 / SDE-3 preparation with sustainable hours, protected sleep, daily walk, and daily reading.
non_negotiables: Protect sleep. Do not routinely sacrifice sleep for study hours.
Do not force a 5 AM routine. Morning is maintenance, not technical study.
DSA should be consistent, not excessive. One serious problem plus review beats two rushed problems.
Use Thursday and weekends for deep work.
Learn AI from fundamentals, not only API wrappers.

mon.label: Monday
mon.summary: Work 9–7. Night: DSA, then LLD. Walk + book + sleep protected.

blocks.title: Morning routine
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Water, wash, sunlight, light movement, shower. No DSA, HLD, or AI in the morning.

blocks.title: Commute / buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep the morning predictable. Do not start technical study.

blocks.title: Work
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Office hours. The learning day starts after decompression at 7:00 PM.

blocks.title: Decompression
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Travel, tea, short walk, personal reset. Do not immediately start studying.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: 7:30–7:40 review yesterday. 7:40–8:30 one serious new problem. 8:30–9:00 second problem, redo, or notes. Prefer one serious problem plus review.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: No technical studying. Let the DSA session settle.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Dinner can run later. If it shifts, shift the walk and the second study block with it — do not compress everything.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk. This is a non-negotiable transition into the second study session.

blocks.title: LLD
blocks.subject: lld
blocks.guide: Monday secondary subject is LLD. Aim for a complete design slice: interfaces, SOLID, and why the design is extensible.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: Fixed 30-minute reading block. Do not convert this into another technical-study block.

blocks.title: Shutdown
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Prepare tomorrow, set priorities, light reading or music. No work. Target sleep 11:45 PM–12:15 AM.

blocks.title: Morning routine
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Water, wash, sunlight, light movement, shower. No technical study.

blocks.title: Commute / buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep the morning predictable.

blocks.title: Work
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Office hours. Learning starts after 7:00 PM decompression.

blocks.title: Decompression
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Reset before DSA. Do not jump straight into a problem.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: Review yesterday, then one serious problem, then notes or a redo. Explain brute force → bottleneck → observation → optimal → complexity → edges.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: No technical studying.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: If dinner is late, shift walk and HLD with it.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk before HLD.

blocks.title: HLD
blocks.subject: hld
blocks.guide: Tuesday secondary subject is HLD. Go past Client → API → Service → DB. Ask: why this design instead of another?

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: 30 minutes of reading. Keep it non-technical-study.

blocks.title: Shutdown
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Prepare tomorrow. Protect sleep.

wed.label: Wednesday
wed.summary: Work 9–7. Night: DSA, then AI internals.

blocks.title: Morning routine
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Maintenance only. No AI study in the morning.

blocks.title: Commute / buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep the morning predictable.

blocks.title: Work
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Office hours.

blocks.title: Decompression
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Reset before DSA.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: One serious problem plus review. Do not rush two problems.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: No technical studying.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Shift walk and AI if dinner runs late.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk.

blocks.title: AI
blocks.subject: ai
blocks.guide: Wednesday secondary subject is AI. Study internals (tokenization, attention, logits, sampling) rather than only wrappers. Build while learning.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: 30-minute reading block.

blocks.title: Shutdown
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Prepare tomorrow. Protect sleep.

thu.label: Thursday
thu.summary: WFH. Work wraps ~5 PM. Highest-value weekday: DSA, a complete design, then AI.

blocks.title: Morning routine
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Same morning maintenance. Do not add extra study just because you are at home.

blocks.title: Buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Ease into the workday.

blocks.title: Work
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Work from home. Wrap around 5:00 PM.

blocks.title: Finish work / reset
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Close work cleanly. Do not immediately grind for five hours.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: Longer DSA block. Good day for a harder Medium or a full pattern review.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Protect the break. Deep work needs gaps.

blocks.title: HLD / LLD
blocks.subject: hld_lld_alt
blocks.guide: Complete one LLD design or one system-design exercise. Thursday is for finishing, not sampling.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: No technical studying.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Dinner, then walk, then AI. Do not skip the walk to squeeze more study.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk.

blocks.title: AI
blocks.subject: ai
blocks.guide: Thursday night is for AI implementation work — a project slice, not only reading.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: 30-minute reading block.

blocks.title: Shutdown
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Sleep around midnight. Protect total sleep.

fri.label: Friday
fri.summary: Work 9–7. Night: DSA, then HLD or LLD (alternating weeks).

blocks.title: Morning routine
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Maintenance only.

blocks.title: Commute / buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep the morning predictable.

blocks.title: Work
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Office hours.

blocks.title: Decompression
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Reset before DSA.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: One serious problem plus review.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: No technical studying.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: If dinner is late, shift walk and the secondary block.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk.

blocks.title: HLD / LLD
blocks.subject: hld_lld_alt
blocks.guide: Friday alternates HLD and LLD. The dashboard picks this week's subject so it does not collide with Thursday.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: 30-minute reading block.

blocks.title: Shutdown
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Protect sleep. Weekend deep work starts Saturday morning, not tonight.

sat.label: Saturday
sat.summary: Long-focus day: ~4–5 hours. DSA, LLD, AI. Evening free.

blocks.title: Wake / breakfast / movement
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Ease in. Do not start DSA at the breakfast table.

blocks.title: Buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Get to the desk for a 10:00 start.

blocks.title: DSA
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: Two-hour Saturday DSA. Quality over volume. Write the explanation flow for each problem.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Step away. This is not a five-hour marathon.

blocks.title: LLD
blocks.subject: lld
blocks.guide: 1.5 hours LLD. Prefer a complete design, or continue a machine-coding project.

blocks.title: Personal time
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Protected free time. Do not fill this with extra study by default.

blocks.title: AI
blocks.subject: ai
blocks.guide: 1.5 hours AI. Build a slice of the current AI project (NN, transformer, RAG, or agent).

blocks.title: Evening free
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Evening is free. Dinner still happens around 9:30.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Dinner.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk.

blocks.title: Wind down
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep the night easy. Reading starts at 11:30.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: Saturday reading block is 11:30 PM–12:00 AM.

sun.label: Sunday
sun.summary: Mocks, HLD, weekly review. Recovery after 5:30 PM.

blocks.title: Wake / breakfast
blocks.subject: morning
blocks.guide: Ease in. Contest-style DSA starts at 10:00.

blocks.title: Buffer
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Set a timer for mock conditions.

blocks.title: DSA mock
blocks.subject: dsa
blocks.guide: Timed / contest-style practice. Track time-to-solve. Do not look up the pattern immediately.

blocks.title: Break
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Full hour. Eat, walk around, reset.

blocks.title: HLD
blocks.subject: hld
blocks.guide: System-design mock. Cover failure modes, capacity, consistency, and why not the alternative.

blocks.title: Lunch / rest
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Protected rest. Do not skip this to add another mock.

blocks.title: HLD / project architecture
blocks.subject: hld
blocks.guide: Second design block or a production-depth pass on a real project: failure, retries, idempotency, observability.

blocks.title: Free time + weekly review
blocks.subject: review
blocks.guide: Personal time. Before the night ends, fill the weekly review: DSA, LLD, HLD, AI, sleep, walks, reading, energy.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Dinner.

blocks.title: Walk
blocks.subject: walk
blocks.guide: 20-minute walk.

blocks.title: Wind down
blocks.subject: none
blocks.guide: Keep Sunday night light. Reading at 11:20.

blocks.title: Reading
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.guide: 30-minute reading block.
